items.title: Hedera Ambassador Program
items.claim: Hedera’s official page visibly links an Apply Now route and states its roles and non-cash benefits.

items.title: Cyfrin Ambassadors
items.claim: Cyfrin’s official page invites applications and describes review, interview, work and non-cash benefits.

items.title: Nexo Crypto Ambassador Program
items.claim: Nexo’s official page contains an ambassador form and describes seniority signals, work and unspecified compensation claims.

items.title: Introducing the Soneium Ambassador Program
items.claim: Soneium’s 29 Jun 2026 official announcement opened a program but does not by itself confirm current hosted-form acceptance.

items.title: Solana University Ambassador Program
items.claim: Solana’s official page publishes a 1 Sep close date while still rendering application fields.

items.title: PIVX Ambassador Program
items.claim: PIVX’s official page says positions are referral-only.

items.title: FTC: What to know about cryptocurrency and scams
items.claim: FTC guidance says a purported crypto job requiring an advance crypto payment is a scam.

items.title: FBI: Work-from-home scams
items.claim: FBI guidance warns of task scams that require crypto deposits to unlock work.
